## GW_05.1_aq: lg3_std

### Toegepast model

```{r}
respvar <- "lg3_std"
modelcomponent_tempnoise <- "Precision for hydroyear_std_short"
```

```{r include=FALSE}
rds_filepath <- file.path(datapath, "binary/simmodels",
                          str_c("model_gw51a_", respvar, ".rds"))
modelname <- basename(rds_filepath) %>% str_remove(".rds")
if (exists(modelname)) {
  M1 <- modelname %>% as.name %>% eval
} else {
  M1 <- readRDS(rds_filepath)
}
```

De modelvorm die werd gefit ten behoeve van simulaties, ziet er uit als volgt:

```{r}
M1$.args$formula
```

### Basisset van steekproeven zonder trend

```{r}
modelterms_type <- 
    targetpop %>% 
    filter(scheme == "GW_05.1_aq") %>% 
    distinct(type) %>% 
    arrange(type) %>% 
    mutate(type = droplevels(type),
           modelterm = str_c("type", type),
           modelterm = ifelse(type == "3110", "type3130_aom", modelterm))
```



### Schatting van spatiale variantie per type

We simuleren een grote steekproef om de spatiale variantiecomponent per type te bepalen.

```{r eval=params$simulate_typevariance}
nsim <- nlocs_per_type * nrow(modelterms_type)
linear_trend <- 0
design_matrix <- 
  tibble(location = str_c("simloc_", str_pad(1:nsim, 5, pad = "0")) %>% as.factor,
         type = rep(modelterms_type$type, each = nsim / nrow(modelterms_type)),
         modelterm_type = rep(modelterms_type$modelterm, 
                              each = nsim / nrow(modelterms_type))) %>% 
  tidyr::expand(nesting(location, type, modelterm_type),
                nesting(time = 1:12,
                        temporal_increase = time * linear_trend))
```


```{r results="hide", eval=params$simulate_typevariance}
# latent_names <- M1$misc$configs$contents$tag
gw51a_large_simsample <- 
  simulate_modelterms(model = M1,
                      design_matrix = design_matrix,
                      nr_nodes = 7,
                      simulate_response = TRUE) %>% 
  .$response_sim
```

```{r include=FALSE}
rds_filepath <- file.path(datapath, "binary/simobs",
                          str_c("gw51a_large_simsample", respvar, ".rds"))
if (params$simulate_typevariance) {
    saveRDS(gw51a_large_simsample, rds_filepath)
} else {
  gw51a_large_simsample <- readRDS(rds_filepath)
}
```
